user.title: Configure EZVIZ camera
user.description: Add one camera per entry. The serial number is its unique identity; the initial display name comes from EZVIZ Cloud and can later be renamed in Home Assistant. The verification code is checked during playback. Optionally upload a product image; no upload means no image.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Luxe EZVIZ
reconfigure.description: Leave AppSecret or verification code blank to keep the saved value. This form will not reveal the stored secrets.

init.title: Camera product image
init.description: Upload or replace an image, or remove the current one. No image is shown if none is uploaded. This only affects the current camera.
